status.en: 19 armed incidents reported in the past seven days, 90% more than the week before, most of them in Mogadishu, Puntland and Baidoa.
status.nb: 19 væpnede hendelser meldt de siste sju dagene, 90 prosent flere enn uken før, flest i Mogadishu, Puntland og Baidoa.

summary.en: Fitgharan forces now control the Mogadishu-Baidoa corridor while Laftagareen forces have seized Buurhakaba and another town in the Bay region, expanding fighting in southern Somalia. Al Shabaab detonated an IED in Mandera, injuring six civilians, and the ICRC treated 148 wounded after heavy combat in Baidoa. Ethiopia announced the withdrawal of more than 3,000 troops from Somalia as its own civil war intensifies and has refused to intervene in the South West State conflict. The UAE carried out its first drone strike in nearly a year, killing four family members including a pregnant teenager in Puntland, and the US and UAE launched airstrikes against al-Shabaab in northern Somalia. 2,284 battle-related deaths in 2024, according to UCDP.
summary.nb: Fitgharan-styrkene kontrollerer nå korridoren mellom Mogadishu og Baidoa, mens Laftagareen-styrkene har erobret Buurhakaba og en annen by i Bay-regionen, og utvider kampene i sørlige Somalia. Al Shabaab detonerte en IED i Mandera, og seks sivile ble skadet, og Røde Kors behandlet 148 sårede etter tungt kamphandling i Baidoa. Etiopia kunngjorde at mer enn 3 000 soldater trekkes tilbake fra Somalia ettersom den interne borgerkrigen i landet intensiveres, og har nektet å intervenere i konflikten i South West State. De forente arabiske emirater gjennomførte sitt første droneangrep på nesten ett år, og drepte fire familiemedlemmer, inkludert en gravid tenåring, i Puntland, og USA og De forente arabiske emirater utførte luftangrep mot al Shabaab i Nord-Somalia. 2 284 dødsfall knyttet til kamper i 2024, ifølge UCDP.

background.title: Somali Civil War (2009–present)
background.extract: The ongoing phase of the Somali Civil War began in 2009 and is concentrated in southern and central Somalia, primarily between the forces of the Federal Government of Somalia (FGS), assisted by African Union peacekeeping forces, and the Islamist militant group al-Shabaab, which pledged allegiance to al-Qaeda in 2012.
